caveats: Six-block t95 intervals assume independent approximately normal differences.
All valid blocks retained; multiple comparisons limit interpretation.
Rank-local remainder boundaries do not define one synchronized global window.
Inclusive host timers overlap and are not GPU execution times.
Cold Lustre may conceal compute overhead; server caches are uncontrolled.

inputs.reference_derivation: CPU dgram decoding of five hash-verified SMD streams; known 200/10000 timestamps, byte totals and prefixes independently rechecked; 1000-event reference derived identically. Reused 19 validated CPU calibration pixels.

perlmutter.report_correction: B-off uses RequestedConstants.refresh; original REPORT.md selected SharedRequestedConstants.refresh and displayed zero. Values here retain the measured private timer.

sample_mapping_audit.raw_artifact_naming: {tag}.log and {tag}-command.json under the recorded sweep directory
sample_mapping_audit.sample_metadata_alignment: sample_metadata[i] identifies metrics[*].samples[i] and timers[*].samples[i]; i is zero-based. Each arm is sorted by repetition. position_in_repetition is one-based; clean_execution_index_zero_based is global across both event counts and all arms.
